name: Fargo Public Library Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help behind the scenes at the library. Teens shelve books, decorate the teen area and prepare craft supplies. Tasks change by session.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 12 to 18. A parent or guardian must sign the Teen Volunteer Permission Form.
duration: One session of 2 hours (1 to 3 pm) on the first Saturday of each month, October to May.
deadline_text: Register for each session. Upcoming dates on the page: Nov 7, Dec 5, Jan 2, Feb 6, Mar 6, Apr 3 and May 1. Locations switch between the Main Library and the Dr. James Carlson Library.
how_to_apply: Register for each session at programregistration.library.fargond.gov or call 701.241.1495. Bring the signed permission form to your first session. The form is on the City of Fargo website.
notes: The page lists the month and day for each session but not the year. A good fit for a first volunteer experience; no commitment beyond a single session.
